violated_contract: A user-facing or automation operation with a bounded response contract must not directly await a dependency that can ignore task cancellation. Cancellation is cooperative, so a decoder blocked in first-use model loading can keep the caller open indefinitely even after the client has given up.
canonical_prevention: Enforce the response deadline at the dependency boundary with DeadlinedOperation, abandon any result that arrives after the deadline, and preserve timeout versus caller-cancellation as distinct typed outcomes. Exercise the production boundary with a fake dependency that deliberately ignores cancellation and assert both the bounded return and the automation error code.
